title: Add a pytest suite with a coverage floor to onfinance-db-model-master
description: In applications/db-models/repos/onfinance-db-model-master (Python, setup.py, default branch master, pinned 70b3633e), create tests/ with pytest unit tests covering the model classes and validators in the onfinance_db_model_master package. Start with the models other internal services import. Add pytest.ini (testpaths = tests) and .coveragerc with `[run] source = onfinance_db_model_master` and `[report] fail_under = <floor of measured coverage>`. Add requirements-dev.txt pinning pytest and pytest-cov with hashes resolved from https://pypi.org/simple, as dependencyPolicy.lockfilesRequired and allowedRegistries require. Merge by pull request with 1 approval. The package's runtime install_requires in setup.py stays unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria: `pip install --require-hashes -r requirements-dev.txt && pip install -e . && pytest --cov --cov-report=term-missing` exits 0 on master and reports coverage at or above the fail_under value in .coveragerc.

Lowering fail_under by editing the config is not needed for the negative check: temporarily removing one test module makes `pytest --cov` exit non-zero with 'FAIL Required test coverage of N% not reached' (command output attached).
tests/ contains at least one test module per top-level model module in onfinance_db_model_master (file listing attached).

verificationMethod.description: Reviewer checks the PR diff for tests/, pytest.ini, .coveragerc (fail_under set to the measured floor) and a hash-pinned requirements-dev.txt from pypi.org, then runs `pytest --cov` locally at the merge commit. Expected: exit 0 with coverage >= fail_under, and non-zero when a test module is removed.

rootCause.description: The db-models library was onboarded under a policy gate that names vitest, a JavaScript runner, and nobody translated it to a Python test runner. As a result the repo has no tests and no coverage configuration, so no gate could run even if CI existed.
